events.title: Innovations in complex organisations
events.description: Start your morning with great coffee, a delicious breakfast and big conversations around leading innovation☕🥐 Innovation is rarely straightforward. Across industries, leaders must navigate legacy systems, regulation, workforce pressures, competing stakeholder needs and the challenge of turning ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes. Register to join here! This breakfast panel explores ‘Innovation in Complex Organisations’, with practical lessons on leadership, transformation and creating meaningful change that apply far beyond healthcare. [Hear from industry leaders] Andrew (Drew) Hebbron MBA GAICD ( Queensland Ambulance Service ) Aarti Bajaj (AMS) ( Lumus Imaging ) Craig Rowsell ( Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct ) Whether you’re a business leader, founder or curious professional, this is a great opportunity to connect with the community over breakfast and leave with fresh ideas. [ Griffith University MBA Event Details] Date: Thursday 10 September Time: 7:00am – 9:30am Location: Cohort Innovation Space Register to join here!

events.title: AWSN Event: Beginner friendly capture the flag
events.description: Facilitated by Margeaux Prince and Paula Sillars, this hands-on, beginner-friendly workshop is designed to help you build confidence and learn the fundamentals of CTF in a supportive and inclusive environment. When: Sat 12 Sept, 8:45AM Where: Cohort Innovation Space Learn more here
